title: Entire Home | Quiet Neighborhood | Private Yard
description:
Welcome to Brookwood Terrace! Embrace the mid-century modern aesthetics as you sink into plush sofas or gather around the dining table for a meal prepared from the adjacent kitchen. Then, unwind in comfortable bedrooms or in the downstairs media room!

Located in a quiet and prime neighborhood, our home ensures easy access to local attractions, making it the perfect retreat for a fun and memorable stay

The space
Bathrooms: Our home has two full bathrooms with showers and two half baths with modern fixtures and a retro touch—refresh, unwind, and enjoy!

Bedrooms: Sleep soundly in three bedrooms, each with a Tempur-Pedic mattress for ultimate comfort. There is queen sleeper sofa in the media room that offers a 4th bed for sleeping. Also note that one bedroom has steps. 

Kitchen: Our kitchen has all the essentials, ready for you to whip up delicious meals to enjoy in the spacious dining room.

Media Room: Movie nights just got better! Enjoy your favorite films and shows on a 65” smart TV in our comfy media room.

Laundry: Travel light with two sets of washers and dryers—fresh clothes, no hassle.

Connectivity: High-speed 1G fiber internet keeps you online for work, streaming, or sharing your adventures.

Bonus Perks:
✔ A library of books & board games
✔ Outdoor grill & dining area
✔ Multiple Keurigs for coffee lovers
✔ Cozy blankets for chilly evenings

Book now and experience a stay where comfort meets convenience—your unforgettable escape starts here!

Guest access
There is a keypad on the back door that grants you access into the house. Access code sent upon booking.
